Wide landscape about 1920x1080. NO overall image title or title banner, NO Android robot, NO speech bubble, no watermark or brand lettering. Main goal: show ordinary Activity cold-start spanning three processes, with wait-for-finish-attach enabled and on-demand fork. Draw three vertical process swimlanes left to right: "system_server", "Zygote", "App 进程". Time downwards. Within system_server upper node "ATMS → AMS / ProcessList". Ordered interactions: (1) system_server to Zygote ORANGE arrow "Socket：创建请求"; (2) Zygote to App GREEN arrow "fork + 特化", arriving at App node "ActivityThread.main()"; separate return arrow Zygote to system_server ORANGE "返回 PID". Do NOT draw a sequential dependency from returned PID to the App main/attach; put compact note "PID 返回与回连可并发". (3) App to system_server ORANGE arrow "Binder：attachApplication"; (4) system_server to App ORANGE arrow "Binder：bindApplication（oneway）"; under App node "主线程：Application 初始化"; (5) App to system_server ORANGE arrow "Binder：finishAttachApplication"; (6) system_server to App ORANGE arrow "Binder：启动 Activity 事务"; App final node "Activity 生命周期". Use enough vertical spacing. Legend at bottom-left "橙色：跨进程通信" and "绿色：创建子进程". Bottom note "示例条件：普通 Activity 冷启动；等待 finishAttach 开启；按需 fork". Character points left toward final App node, pointer ends outside frame, modest calm teaching expression. Avoid adding any other nodes, events or dotted lines with unspecified semantics.
